{{Quote|That leaves Senator Rhodi, Senator Plada, Danascar, we can't possibly make them all...|Perrin Fertha talking to Mon Mothma about what parties to attend during Senator Senate Investiture|<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />}}
'''Plada''' was a [[senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Senate]]. Senator Plada hosted a party during [[Senate Investiture]]<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> in [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Episode Date">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" established that the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" take place during [[3 BBY]].</ref> Before the party, [[Mon Mothma]] and her [[Marriage|spouse]], [[Perrin Fertha]] discussed if they would be able to make the senator's gathering due to all the other events taking place that day.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Behind the scenes==
Plada was mentioned in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
